articles.title: Schools in Italy, Scotland and Northern Ireland hit by threats in suspected bomb hoax
articles.summary: More than 6,000 Italian schools received a threat. Authorities in all three countries say there appears to be no risk to the public. It is not known if the incidents are linked.

articles.title: Missing 11-month-old baby found buried alive in a crate in South Carolina
articles.summary: Officials say the child was found close to his father's home on Tuesday, a day after he was taken, and is being cared for in hospital.

articles.title: Russia-Ukraine talks turn to post-war security but end without breakthrough
articles.summary: Talks in Abu Dhabi centred around Europe's security framework, with US envoys due to meet Putin and Zelensky on Thursday.

articles.title: Spain sees widespread disruption in first general strike for 14 years
articles.summary: Protests are also expected in the biggest cities less than three weeks before Spaniards vote in parliamentary elections.

articles.title: Three Iran-backed suspects plotted attacks including RAF Fairford incident, US says
articles.summary: The US Department of Justice says the men were involved in a string of plots, including a major incident near the UK airbase that is used by US armed forces.

articles.title: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent relocated after alleged Iranian threats
articles.summary: Bessent is now one of several Trump administration officials to live on military bases due to safety concerns.

articles.title: Indonesia's vice president resigns amid signs ruling alliance is fraying
articles.summary: The news comes at a turbulent time for Prabowo, who faces a growing rift with his predecessor Joko Widodo.

articles.title: Kidnapper, 74, escapes from house arrest in Argentina by abseiling from balcony
articles.summary: Leonardo Bertulazzi, a former member of the Marxist guerrilla group the Red Brigades, was about to be extradited to his home country of Italy.

articles.title: Egyptian journalist's retrial adjourned as UN warns of 'assaults on press freedom'
articles.summary: Mada Masr editor-in-chief Lina Attalah is being tried on the charge of "publishing false news" and potentially faces imprisonment.

articles.title: Four grizzly bears killed in Canada after fatal attack on mother and daughter
articles.summary: The sow and her three cubs were responsible for killing Jennifer Balcarras, 48, and her daughter Selah Reed, 20, earlier this month.

articles.title: Kenya discharges last Ebola patient in major milestone towards virus-free status
articles.summary: The country begins a 42-day countdown to being declared Ebola-free, provided no new cases are recorded.

articles.title: Haitian PM praises El Salvador after joint strike on alleged home of gang leader
articles.summary: The 400 Mawozo gang was targeted by El Salvador's military, which has deployed thousands of troops to combat Haiti's gang violence crisis.

articles.title: US House blocks bid to impeach Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth
articles.summary: Trump welcomes the outcome, praising Hegseth as a "Great American Patriot", but Democrats can try again next year.

articles.title: Transport workers in Chile block highways in protest over surging fuel prices
articles.summary: Hundreds of bus and lorry drivers are blocking traffic along major highway routes across the country.

articles.title: Watch: Vinícius Jr's surprise message to boy who received prosthetic legs after Sudan drone strike
articles.summary: Real Madrid player Vinícius Jr sent a surprise message to 13-year-old fan Zaher who lost both his legs after being hit by a drone in Khartoum, in 2024.

articles.title: 'They will kill you too': Sonia Gandhi's turbulent journey in Indian politics
articles.summary: Sonia Gandhi's memoir revisits love, loss and political inheritance, offering a deeply personal defence of her family and its legacy.

articles.title: Vinícius Jr sends message to Sudan boy who received prosthetic legs after BBC report sparks appeal
articles.summary: Double amputee Zaher told the BBC last year about his favourite footballer and a dream of being able to walk again.

articles.title: 'It can kill us': Kenyans fear impact of El Niño with floods predicted
articles.summary: Forecasters warn that this year's El Niño could be one of the strongest on record, with heavy rain and flooding in Kenya.
